svg.text: Map, rename and the register files
Eight uops a cycle get physical registers. Moves, zeroing and small immediates finish here and never issue.

cmp + branch fusion reads at most 4 registers per 6 instructions ○
Sub-register moves, MOV from xzr and EOR self-zero stay real ops. 8 per 8 immediates is
